parsed.observations: Potted plant with mostly green, curling leaves; some pale yellow discoloration and a dry leaf tip are visible. Many leaf surfaces are blurred or obscured. White fibers appear associated with the support twine. No distinct pustules, powdery colonies, or blotches containing black dots are discernible.
parsed.summary: Disease status is uncertain because blurred and obscured leaf surfaces show no diagnostic disease signs, while mild discoloration alone is insufficient for classification.
